'''Xahn's Crossing''' was the confluence of several rivers, including the [[Mephyt River|Krisa River]], located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. It was used as a racetrack for the [[Nashal River Race]].<ref name="SWG:NRT" />
